text:
alex: heads up — deploy-bot alerted on a partial publish during the quiet window. python package 2.4.0 is live on PyPI but npm still shows 2.3.1 (dist-tag 'latest' pointing to 2.3.1). we also have the deprecation announcement for 2.2.0 scheduled tomorrow. how do we want to handle? rollback, yank, or republish a patch?

marta: ack. can you paste the deploy-bot logs? :eyes:

ci-bot: deploy-bot report: publish step failed for npm package @redwood/sdk-ts on runners-us-east-1 (exit code 1). PyPI upload completed. npm upload error: 403 EACCESS (package publish denied) — token scope issue.

ryan: that 403 is consistent with the npm token lacking the publish:packages scope after the token rotation last week. so npm never got the artifact. wheel/sdist are on PyPI already.

jamie: ugh. that means we can’t re-use 2.4.0 on PyPI if we republish — PyPI forbids re-uploading same version. options: yank 2.4.0 on PyPI then publish 2.4.1 (patch) with identical changelog entry, and publish npm 2.4.1. or yank npm dist-tag and republish npm only to 2.4.1 and leave PyPI as-is (but that causes version mismatch).

pat: leaning to republish as 2.4.1 across both registries so versions match. also update release notes and add a short "publish fix" entry. keep deprecation schedule intact but postpone public announcement until we confirm npm published.

alex: agreed. plan: (1) create 2.4.1, (2) run npm publish with correct token, (3) build/sign py wheels and upload via twine for 2.4.1, (4) update changelog + release notes and then trigger the deprecation announcement once confirmed. timeline?

jamie: i can build and upload py artifacts. i'll bump version to 2.4.1 on the release branch and run: `python -m build && twine upload dist/*` — note we need GPG signing for wheels in our pipeline via GPG_KEY env. if missing, twine will still upload but code-sign checks fail on some customers.

ryan: i'll handle npm publish once token rotated. command i'll run locally: `npm publish --access public --tag latest` and then sanity-check `npm dist-tag ls @redwood/sdk-ts`. if we want a staged roll, publish with `--tag canary` then retag to latest after smoke.

marta: two questions — do we want to yank 2.4.0 on PyPI first? yanking is not reversible and will show as yanked in pip installs. Also some internal services might have already pinned 2.4.0.

jamie: yanking isn't necessary if we never intended 2.4.0 as final. better to leave 2.4.0 for now, publish 2.4.1, and then update internal pins to 2.4.1. yanking would be disruptive.

pat: agree no yank. instead, push a short post to #release-notes and add a note in the changelog "2.4.1: republished to correct cross-registry publish mismatch". also run a quick canary verification on staging.

deploy-bot: action queued: create release branch `release/2.4.1` -> run CI -> build artifacts -> await manual publish approvals.

jamie: taking release/2.4.1 now. will run packaging steps and confirm artifacts in S3.

ryan: i'll rotate npm token in Vault and then attempt publish. ETA ~20m. will publish to `--tag canary` first, smoke in prod-preview, then retag to `latest` if good.

alex: if npm/pypi are both good, i'll push the deprecation announcement to go out tomorrow morning. if npm fails again we hold announcement.

marta: also update the SDK compatibility note in the console docs so that the docs don't reference 2.4.0 explicitly. small doc change should ship with the release.

jamie: quick note — CI reported missing manylinux wheel variant for linux-x86_64 in the prior build. i'll ensure the manylinux wheel is regenerated for 2.4.1. command: `docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/io quay.io/pypa/manylinux2014_x86_64 /io/build-wheels.sh`

pat: i will notify support and the CSMs about a brief version bump and to hold on sending the deprecation email until i confirm.

ryan: npm publish (canary) succeeded. `npm dist-tag ls @redwood/sdk-ts` shows `canary: 2.4.1`. smoke tests passing on prod-preview.

jamie: py wheels uploaded for 2.4.1 and signed. twine output: `Uploading distributions to https://upload.pypi.org/legacy/` -> 100% done. artifacts available.

alex: awesome. i'm updating the changelog and release notes now. copy for release-notes channel: "2.4.1 republished to address an incomplete npm publish during the quiet window. No functional changes. Patch bumped for registry consistency."

marta: can we also add a note in the deprecation announcement that we delayed public send by ~1hr to align publishing? helps transparency.

pat: agreed. i'll sign off on the announcement after alex updates it.

alex: announcement updated and staged. deprecation email scheduled for 8:30am tomorrow; if either of you see anything odd overnight please flag. thanks all. :tada:

ci-bot: deploy-bot: release/2.4.1 pipeline completed. smoke checks green.

pat: closing loop — i'll send the internal heads-up and hold public announcement until 8:30am. good quick response team. :thumbsup:
